Every release of BackDown, newest first. The latest is **1.0.0-beta.9**; the [Download page](/download/) always has the current one, and `backdown update` installs it, checking the release's signature first. Each page is that release's notes as published on [GitHub](https://github.com/BuenGenio/backdown-releases/releases).
